chat.welcomeMessage:
Mwaramutse! 👋 Ndi umufasha wanyu mu buhinzi.

Nshobora kubafasha mu:
• Imyaka, imboga, imbuto n'indabyo
• Amatungo, inkoko n'amafi
• Kurwanya udukoko n'indwara
• Itegenanyagihe n'ubujyanama ku masoko

Mbufashe iki uyu munsi?

agrivision.name: AgriVision
agrivision.tagline: Gusuzuma no kumenya indwara z'ibihingwa bikoresheje AI
agrivision.description: Sesengura amafoto y'ibihingwa umenye indwara, udukoko, n'ibura ry'intungamubiri. Umenye icyo aricyo ako kanya n'inama z'ubuvuzi n'uko wakwirinda.

isdaSoil.name: ISDA Ubutaka
isdaSoil.tagline: Ibiranga ubutaka n'isesengura ry'intungamubiri kuri Afurika
isdaSoil.description: Bona amakuru yimbitse ku butaka harimo pH, azote, fosifore, potasiyumu n'izindi ntungamubiri. Biboneka muri Afurika yose kuri metero 30.

accuweather.name: AccuWeather
accuweather.tagline: Ibihe by'ubu n'iteganyagihe ku Isi hose
accuweather.description: Bona amakuru y'igihe n'ikirere ako kanya harimo ubushyuhe, ubuhehere, umuvuduko w'umuyaga n'imvura. Iteganyagihe riboneka kugeza ku minsi 15.

gapWeather.name: GAP Igihe
gapWeather.description: Iteganyagihe ryihariye ry'ubuhinzi muri Kenya. Harimo ihumanywa, imirasire y'izuba, n'iteganyagihe ry'imvura rihuye n'imyanzuro y'ubuhinzi.

edacap.name: EDACaP Ibihe
edacap.description: Amakuru y'igihembwe arebana n'ikirere harimo ubushyuhe n'imvura biteganijwe. Bifasha abahinzi gutegura igihe cyo gutera n'icyo gusarura.

weatherapi.name: WeatherAPI
weatherapi.description: Serivisi yuzuye itanga amakuru y'ikirere y'ibihe by'ubu n'iteganyagihe ku Isi hose.

tomorrowIo.name: Tomorrow.io
tomorrowIo.description: Urubuga rw'ubwenge bw'ikirere rugezweho rutanga iteganyagihe ryiza cyane n'ubushobozi bwo guhanura ako kanya.

feedFormulation.name: Gutegura Ibiryo
feedFormulation.tagline: Kubara ibiryo byiza ku matungo y'inshyushyu
feedFormulation.description: Bara imvange y'ibiryo bihendutse cyane ku matungo y'inshyushyu yawe. Hashingiwe ku ntego z'umusaruro w'amata, ibiro by'umubiri, n'ibiryo biboneka mu karere.

nextgen.name: Ifumbire ya NextGen
nextgen.tagline: Inama z'ifumbire zihariye ku butaka bwa Etiyopiya
nextgen.description: Bona inama z'ifumbire zinoze zishingiye aho uherereye. Harimo inama z'ifumbire y'imborera (ifumbire mvaruganda, iy'inyamaswa nto) n'iy'inyabutare (Urea, NPS).

decisionTree.name: Amabwiriza y'Ibihingwa
decisionTree.tagline: Inama zishingiye ku kigero cy'ikimera kuri Kenya
decisionTree.description: Bona inama zo gucunga ibihingwa zishingiye ku kigero cyabyo n'ibihe by'ikirere by'ubu. Bifasha gufata ibyemezo ku gihe ku bijyanye no kurwanya udukoko, kuhira, no gusarura.

gapAgriculture.name: GAP Ubuhinzi
gapAgriculture.description: Serivisi rusange z'inama z'ubuhinzi zo gucunga ibihingwa n'amatungo.
